title: Open a new version of a workflow

v1.description: What happens when another version of an existing workflow is asked for: a draft is created beside the versions already there, carrying whatever diagram the request brought to start from. A draft rather than anything else, because a version that instances could be created from should be one somebody has decided to activate. Being itself a workflow, a deployment that wants a new version to be announced, or to be refused while another draft is open, edits this definition rather than the platform.
